level2.title: The Christ of God
level2.story: Once when Jesus was praying alone with His disciples, He asked, "Whom do the people say that I am?" They said John the Baptist, Elijah, or one of the old prophets risen again. He asked, "But whom do you say that I am?" Peter answered, "The Christ of God." Jesus said, "If any man will come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow Me."
level2.keyLine: Whom do you say that I am? The Christ of God.

actions: Offer up something hard each day
level2.prayer: Jesus, Christ of God, I take up my cross. Amen.
